bug_semantics: Host-side ethos (dist/tools/ethos/ethos.c) decodes SLIP-like serial/TCP frames in _serial_handle_byte() and writes every payload byte through _handle_char(). That helper did serial->frame[serial->framebytes] = c; serial->framebytes++ with no check against the fixed stack buffer serial_t.frame[MTU] (MTU=9000). A crafted framed stream longer than 9000 bytes (Full Disclosure PoC: 9501-byte TCP payload to ./ethos tap0 tcp:127.0.0.1 20000) advances framebytes past the array, producing a stack write (UBSan index 9000 out of bounds; ASan stack-buffer-overflow WRITE of size 1 at ethos.c:186). CWE-121. CVE.org record CVE-2026-22214 is PUBLISHED (not rejected/withdrawn); GHSA withdrawn_at is null. Affected through 2026.01-devel-317; the MCU driver path uses a different bounded tsrb_add_one sink and is not this CVE.
flaw_origin: The unbounded stack write was first authored as new file dist/tools/ethos/ethos.c in 52aec3ad32fbd175a0bae37ca6aa3eb24c671a8a (Kaspar Schleiser, 2016-02-05), a non-merge member of PR #4438. Immediate parent 9e3e485ec0e1af0addaca3a1157e3771701ec057 added only the MCU ethos driver (bounded tsrb_add_one _handle_char) and has no dist/tools/ethos/ethos.c. git log -L :_handle_char and -S 'serial->frame[serial->framebytes] = c;' show those two statements unchanged from that first write until the 2026 bounds check. Later TCP support (a52c781339) only added another input path into the same helper.

Vulnerable sink at introducer 52aec3ad32fbd175a0bae37ca6aa3eb24c671a8a dist/tools/ethos/ethos.c:155-159: static void _handle_char(serial_t *serial, char c) { serial->frame[serial->framebytes] = c; serial->framebytes++; } with serial_t.frame[MTU] and #define MTU 9000 at lines 27 and 113-120. File is a 379-line add (plus Makefile/README/LICENSE); commit is single-parent, not a merge/squash.

Parent drivers/ethos/ethos.c:_handle_char uses tsrb_add_one(&dev->inbuf, c) with overflow reset, a different function/type/buffer.

git log -L ':_handle_char:dist/tools/ethos/ethos.c' yields only 52aec3ad32 (add unbounded write) then dc068a6943 (add bounds check). git log -S 'serial->frame[serial->framebytes] = c;' -- dist/tools/ethos/ethos.c yields only 52aec3ad32. Pre-fix at dc068a6943^ still has the two unbounded statements.
